extDescription.message: Fill the empty margins around the YouTube player with a soft blur that matches the video, or a theme-matched solid color.
extDescription.description: Short description for the Chrome Web Store and extension details.

modeBlur.description: Radio option: blurred video as background.

modeSolid.description: Radio option: flat color behind the player.

reloadButton.description: Button to reload the blur effect on the current page.

reloadingButton.description: Reload button text while the reload is in progress.

modeSolidSub.description: Subtitle for solid mode, shown under the mode name.

blurStrengthLabel.description: Label for the blur-strength slider. Shown only while blur mode is selected.

blurStrengthSliderAria.description: Accessible name for the blur-strength slider.

blurStrengthUnit.description: Unit shown beside the blur-strength number.

solidColorLabel.description: Label for the solid-mode color controls. Shown only while solid mode is selected.

solidColorCustomLabel.description: Label for the custom color picker in solid mode.

solidColorPresetLight.description: Preset swatch: the historical light gray, #f1f1f1.

popupPhrase0.message: Making YouTube easier on the eyes

popupPhrase2.message: Blur the noise, keep the joy

reviewNudgeTitle.description: Title for the optional review prompt shown after about a week of use.

reviewNudgeBody.message: If the softer player background has been useful, would you mind leaving an honest review? It helps other people find the extension. Any rating that matches your experience is welcome.
reviewNudgeBody.description: Body copy for the optional review prompt.

reviewNudgeLeaveReview.description: Primary button on the review prompt.

reviewNudgeSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save that choice. This stays here so you can try again.
reviewNudgeSaveFailed.description: Shown on the review prompt when the dismiss or review choice could not be saved. The prompt stays visible.

reviewNudgeClose.description: Dismiss button on the review prompt. The prompt is shown only once, so this hides it for good.

welcomeTitle.description: Heading on the welcome page opened once after a fresh install.

welcomeTheaterHint.message: The effect shows in theater mode. On a YouTube video, press the t key (or the theater mode button) to see the soft background around the player.
welcomeTheaterHint.description: Welcome page: the effect is visible in theater mode, toggled with the t key on YouTube.

welcomePopupHint.message: Click the youtublur icon in the toolbar to switch between blur and solid color.
welcomePopupHint.description: Welcome page: where to switch between blur and solid.

welcomeClose.description: Welcome page button that closes the tab.

commandToggleMode.description: Command description shown in the browser shortcut settings and the popup. Switches the popup's blur and solid modes.

commandIncreaseBlur.description: Command description for raising blur strength by one slider step (4px, within 8–72).

commandDecreaseBlur.description: Command description for lowering blur strength by one slider step (4px, within 8–72).

shortcutSectionTitle.description: Heading for the keyboard-shortcut list in the popup.

shortcutUnset.description: Shown next to a command that has no keyboard shortcut assigned.

shortcutManage.description: Button that opens the browser's extension shortcut settings.

shortcutManageHint.message: Rebind these in the browser's extension shortcut settings.
shortcutManageHint.description: Hint under the shortcut list. Chrome uses chrome://extensions/shortcuts; Firefox uses commands.openShortcutSettings.

commandOpenPopup.description: Description for the reserved _execute_action command. Opens the toolbar popup. Suggested key is Alt+Shift+U.

commandReloadEffect.description: Description for the reload command. It reapplies the player background. No suggested key is set.
